_comment: Copy to your experiment dir as config.json and edit. Paths are relative to this file unless absolute.
_pinned_sha_comment: The commit BEFORE the fix, and before anyone recorded the answer. Verify with `git log --format='%H %ad %s'` around the fix commit.
_arms_comment: arm_a is the CURRENT text, copied verbatim (md5-check it against the installed file). arm_b is arm_a plus EXACTLY ONE surgical change. Never edit the installed skill.
_grader_rubric_comment: Criteria ONLY. No hypothesis, no arm names, no expected direction.
_n_comment: n=6/arm detects only huge effects. Say so in RESULTS.md. n=25-36/arm is where a 30-40pp swing becomes detectable.
_budget_comment: MEASURE with `ab_harness.py probe`, at least TWICE, then cap at 3-4x the WORST probe with a floor of ~$1 and never below the most expensive run this rig has produced. Do not double a single probe: an observed $0.2559 probe (3 turns) implies $0.51, while runs on that same rig had reached $1.29 over 35 turns, and the exploratory runs a low cap truncates are exactly the ones most likely to differ between arms. The first turn alone can cost $0.20+ in cache-write on the system prompt; a cap set by intuition voids most runs as INCONCLUSIVE and buys zero data (a guessed $0.75 cap would have voided 9 of 12 runs in the reference experiment).
_tools_comment: Read-only by construction keeps the pinned worktree clean and makes the final message the whole deliverable. Everything else is denied, including Skill and Bash.
_keywords_comment: Fingerprint-free mechanical cross-check on the primary outcome. Disagreements with the LLM grader get reported, not silently resolved.

contamination._must_be_present_comment: Proves the bug really is in the pinned tree.
contamination._must_be_absent_comment: Proves nobody recorded the ANSWER in the tree. Sweep .py, .md, tests, comments, plan docs. If the answer is discoverable in-tree, the experiment is worthless.
contamination._later_shas_comment: Commits/artifacts that record the later discovery. `git merge-base --is-ancestor <later> <pin>` must FAIL for each.
